description.narrative:
Despite the many challenges brought on by fullscale war the Government of Ukraine civil society and the private sector share joint accountability to contribute to transformative results for GEWE which the CO plans to bolster UN Women will continue to support the Government together with WROs to adopt revise and repeal legislation to advance GEWE In 2023 sixteen new strategies policies andor action plans with a focus on gender equality were adopted with UN Womens support and in 20252029 UN Women continue contributing to the drafting and implementation of more such policies UN Women will seek to guarantee that the level of influence of civil society organizations working on gender equality and womens empowerment including womens rights organizations in key normative policy and budget processes expands further It will also invest in generating better evidence and data on GEWE to further inform decisionmaking and policy on reform and recovery
